$comment: Thin-P9 motion template v1. `motion_v1` is the machine-evaluable block: every predicate it names is a real fact_predicates key, and anything this product cannot observe is declared in requiresContext rather than invented as a signal.
name: Install-base whitespace expansion
objective: Open an expansion conversation on accounts a partner already holds where the target product is not yet installed.

motion_v1.objective: Open an expansion conversation on accounts a partner already holds where the target product is not yet installed.
requiresContext: Whether the account has evaluated this product category before — no predicate records prior evaluations.
Which partner seller owns the relationship day to day — `partner_accounts` names the partner, not the person.
motion_v1.goalTemplate: Establish whether {{company}} has a case for the partner's target product, which they do not hold today.
motion_v1.campaignGuidance: Lead with the partner relationship, not the product. The opening should reference what the partner already supports at this account and offer a short fit conversation — never a pitch for a product they have not asked about.
measurementAssociations: An opportunity opened on this account after application — association only, never attribution.
A stage change on an existing opportunity for this account.

cta.offer: 30-minute fit conversation with the partner present
cta.fallback: Written summary of what comparable accounts on this partner's book have adopted

seller_cadence.action: Partner seller confirms the account relationship is live and warm
Joint outreach referencing the partner's existing footprint at the account
Fit conversation with the infrastructure owner, partner present
